### Fixed
- **The blocks right in front of a screen are lit.** The row of floor (or wall) along the picture stayed dark: the light came from a hair in front of the picture, so the blocks right at it saw it edge-on. Most visible with a screen standing on the floor.
- **Zone colors blend smoothly in front of the screen** instead of lighting the floor in hard-edged tiles one zone wide (4 blocks on an 8 block wide screen).
- **Displays more than one block deep** light from the picture itself, where Dream Displays draws it, not from the front of their whole block box.
- Each zone now lights as the rectangle it is, so the light right in front of the picture is as bright as a screen that close is; further away it is the same as before.

### Other
- Light rebuilds that take a quarter second or more are logged.

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API
- Dream Displays 1.10.6+ (client)
- Optional: Sodium + Iris, LambDynamicLights (1.20.1 and newer), [Dream Displays Beam](https://github.com/XCraftTM/dreamdisplays-beam) 0.2.1+ (casts light the room too)

Client-only: servers only need Dream Displays itself.
